verdict.headline: No trade yet
verdict.reason: Nothing qualifies yet. EUR/USD, USD/CAD and NZD/USD are sitting at marked levels with no break. USD/JPY and AUD/USD broke resistance but have no retest and trigger. USD/CHF has no levels marked. All stay on the watchlist.

watchlist.missing: Price fell about 90 pips to the marked support and bounced from a low of about 1.1134 without closing below it. No break, so no setup. A candle body closing below 1.1135 with displacement would start a short break-and-retest; the next marked level below does not exist yet.

Level broke with displacement and follow-through (to about 157.91), and price is retesting it now. Lows near 157.58 poked under the line and closed back above, but there is no clean engulfing or pin bar yet, and the M5 structure break can't be confirmed from the M15 chart (marked false). Targeting the 157.91 swing high with SL at 157.55 only gives 1:2 if entry is at or below about 157.67. No marked resistance above price to use as TP.

Price is range-bound between 1.4009 and 1.4028 (about 19 pips). Resistance was tested three times and support three times, with wicks only and no candle body closing beyond either level. No break, so no setup. A full-bodied close beyond either side starts a break and retest; the opposite marked level is under 2x the stop distance at that range, so check 1:2 against a newly marked level. Only the 5-minute chart was sent.

Price pushed above 0.7034 with strong green candles and is at 0.7036, but the break is fresh: no retest yet, so the retest check and the candle trigger are both missing (C for now). Resistance was tested earlier with wicks above it, so watch for a snap-back below. M5 structure break looks likely but only the 5-minute chart was sent. No marked resistance above price to use as TP, so 1:2 can't be checked.

No S/R was marked, so nothing can be graded. Price is in an uptrend and sits near 0.8284 under a swing high of about 0.8290-0.8292 that has been tested twice (possible double top, not confirmed). Mark the levels you want graded; a close below the recent low near 0.8280 would need a trigger and a marked target to check 1:2.

Price is at 0.5702, just under marked resistance at 0.5707, which has been tested four times with wicks and no candle body closing above it. No break, so no setup. A full-bodied close above 0.5707 with follow-through, then a retest that holds with an engulfing or pin bar, would start a long; mark the next resistance above to check 1:2. Marked support is at 0.5677, about 30 pips below.

newsBlocks: The calendar couldn't be confirmed. No red-folder times for today were found. US data usually lands at 5:30am PT; check it before entering anything on USD pairs.
Fed meeting starts today with the decision tomorrow (Oct 28, 11:00am PT); BoC and RBNZ also decide tomorrow. Expect thin, cautious trade.
watchFor: USD/JPY: after 6:00am PT, a clear engulfing or pin bar at the 157.65 retest that holds, with entry at or below about 157.67, SL about 157.55 and TP at 157.91 or a newly marked resistance. Mark the next resistance above price to confirm 1:2.
USD/JPY: a close back below 157.65 before 2:00pm PT makes the break fail (C).
NZD/USD: a full-bodied close above 0.5707 (or below 0.5677), then a retest that holds with a trigger candle. Mark the next level beyond to check 1:2. A fourth rejection at 0.5707 is not a trade.

AUD/USD: a pullback to 0.7034 that holds from above with an engulfing or pin bar after 6:00am PT. Mark the next resistance above price first to confirm 1:2. A close back below 0.7034 makes the break fail (C).
USD/CAD: a full-bodied close above 1.4028 or below 1.4009 with follow-through, then a retest that holds with an engulfing or pin bar. Mark the next level beyond the range to check 1:2.
EUR/USD: a full-bodied close below 1.1135, then a retest that holds from below with a trigger candle. Mark support below price first to check R:R.

Only EUR/USD, USD/JPY, USD/CAD, AUD/USD, USD/CHF and NZD/USD were sent. GBP/USD is not graded. Setups expire 2:00pm PT. EUR/USD, USD/JPY, USD/CHF and NZD/USD were sent on M15; USD/CAD and AUD/USD on M5.
